3906-the-confessions-of-jean-jacques-rou.title: The Confessions Of Jean Jacques Rousseau Volume 06
3906-the-confessions-of-jean-jacques-rou.creator: Unknown
3906-the-confessions-of-jean-jacques-rou.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Nothing that passed during that charming epocha, nothing that I did, said, or thought, has escaped my memory. The time that preceded or followed it, I only recollect by intervals, unequally and confused; but here I remember all as distinctly as if it existed at this moment.

arxiv-1905-10674.title: Compositional Fairness Constraints for Graph Embeddings
arxiv-1905-10674.creator: Avishek Joey Bose, William L. Hamilton
arxiv-1905-10674.description: Abstract Learning high-quality node embeddings is an important building block for machine learning models that operate on graph data, such as social networks and recommender systems. However, existing graph embedding techniques are unable to cope with fairness constraints, e.g., ensuring that the learned representations do not correlate with certain attributes, such as age or gender.

arxiv-2012-11527.title: Can we learn where people come from? Retracing of origins in merging situations
arxiv-2012-11527.creator: Marion Gödel, Luca Spataro, Gerta Köster
arxiv-2012-11527.description: Abstract One crucial information for a pedestrian crowd simulation is the number of agents moving from an origin to a certain target. While this setup has a large impact on the simulation, it is in most setups challenging to find the number of agents that should be spawned at a source in the simulation.

arxiv-2104-07649.title: Mild radial variations of the stellar IMF in the bulge of M31. 2021 Mild radial variations of the stellar IMF in the bulge of M31. – 16
arxiv-2104-07649.creator: F. La Barbera, A, Vazdekis, I. Ferreras, A. Pasquali
arxiv-2104-07649.description: Abstract Using new, homogeneous, long-slit spectroscopy in the wavelength range from ∼ 0.35 \sim 0.35 to ∼ 1 ​ μ \sim 1\,\mu m, we study radial gradients of optical and near-infrared (NIR) IMF-sensitive features along the major axis of the bulge of M31, out to a galactocentric distance of ∼ 200 \sim 200 arcsec ( ∼ 800 \sim 800 pc).

arxiv-2104-14999.title: Analytical approximations for the speed of pacemaker-generated waves
arxiv-2104-14999.creator: Jan Rombouts, Lendert Gelens
arxiv-2104-14999.description: Abstract In an oscillatory medium, a region which oscillates faster than its surroundings can act as a source of outgoing waves. Such pacemaker-generated waves can synchronize the whole medium and are present in many chemical and biological systems, where they are a means of transmitting information at a fixed speed over large distances.

arxiv-2105-07918.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Paul D. Levy, Nham V. Ngo, Klemen Šivic. In this paper we determine, for all r r sufficiently large, the irreducible component(s) of maximal dimension of the variety of commuting r r -tuples of nilpotent elements of 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 n \mathfrak{gl}_{n} .

arxiv-2111-05623.title: FabricFlowNet: Bimanual Cloth Manipulation with a Flow-based Policy
arxiv-2111-05623.creator: Thomas Weng, Sujay Bajracharya, Yufei Wang, Khush Agrawal, David Held
arxiv-2111-05623.description: Abstract We address the problem of goal-directed cloth manipulation, a challenging task due to the deformability of cloth. Our insight is that optical flow, a technique normally used for motion estimation in video, can also provide an effective representation for corresponding cloth poses across observation and goal images.

arxiv-2307-09682.title: Partially Saturated Granular Flow in a Rotating Drum: The Role of Cohesion
arxiv-2307-09682.creator: Mingrui Dong, Zhongzheng Wang, Benjy Marks, Yu Chen, Yixiang Gan
arxiv-2307-09682.description: Abstract Abstract Partially saturated granular flows are common in various natural and industrial processes, such as landslides, mineral handling, and food processing. We conduct experiments and apply the Discrete Element Method (DEM) to study granular flows in rotating drums under partially saturated conditions.

arxiv-2410-11626.title: Quantum Band Structure and Topology in One Dimensional Modulated Plasmonic Crystal
arxiv-2410-11626.creator: Luis Brey, H.A. Fertig
arxiv-2410-11626.description: Abstract Band structures of electrons in a periodic potential are well-known to host topologies that impact their behaviors at edges and interfaces. The concept however is more general than the single-electron setting. In this work, we consider topology of plasmons in a two-dimensional metal, subject to a unidirectional periodicity.

arxiv-2410-16292.title: An evaluation of LLM code generation capabilities through graded exercises
arxiv-2410-16292.creator: Álvaro Barbero Jiménez
arxiv-2410-16292.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Álvaro Barbero Jiménez. Large Language Models have shown prominent capabilities in generating functional code from natural language descriptions. However, a standardized way to evaluate these capabilities in an objective and unbiased manner is still to be found. In this paper we review the current evaluation methods available to this end, and run a new evaluation of the performance of one state-of-the-art model (GPT4-o-mini) in solving curated coding challenges in 8 programming languages, obtained from Codewars, a software development community.

arxiv-2601-01238.title: Evidence Slopes and Effective Dimension in Singular Linear Models
arxiv-2601-01238.creator: Kalyaan Rao
arxiv-2601-01238.description: Abstract Bayesian model selection commonly relies on Laplace’s approximation or BIC, which assume that the effective model dimension equals the number of parameters [ 11 , 5 ] . Singular learning theory replaces this by the real log canonical threshold (RLCT), an effective dimension that can be strictly smaller in overparameterised or low-rank models [ 15 , 16 ] .

pmc-11620194.description: f basal cell carcinoma (BCC) complicating HS, with the aim of raising concerns about the possibility of malignancy in these patients. Patients that had developed malignancies within HS lesions were selected.

pmc-11682161.title: Malignant Insulinoma: Diagnostic Difficulties and Treatment Strategies in a Case of Persistent Hypoglycemia
pmc-11682161.creator: Shubh Mehta, Ahan Banker, Jay V Shah
pmc-11682161.description: Hypoglycemia in non-diabetic individuals is a rare but critical condition that often signals an underlying pathology. Insulinoma, a rare neuroendocrine tumor of the pancreas, is a key differential diagnosis. As the most common functional pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, insulinomas originate from pancreatic islet cells and are predominantly benign. However, malignant cases, although rare, represent a significant diagnostic challenge.

pmc-12413427.title: Modeling within-level latent interaction effects in multilevel vector-autoregressive models
pmc-12413427.creator: Jana Holtmann, Kenneth Koslowski
pmc-12413427.description: The study of time-dependent within-person dynamics has gained popularity in recent years through the use of multilevel (latent) time-series models. However, due to the complexity of the models, model applications are usually limited with respect to the inclusion of time-varying moderating factors on the longitudinal within-person relations between variables.

pmc-13096151.title: Interpretable predictive model for listed companies ESG greenwashing based on XGBoost and SHAP
pmc-13096151.creator: Zhang Jianfeng, Qi Tiantian
pmc-13096151.description: The prediction of ESG greenwashing among listed companies is crucial for ex-ante control of deceptive ESG information disclosures by companies and for early warning of ESG investment risks. Machine learning techniques are commonly used to predict corporate behavior, but their application in ESG greenwashing is limited and lacks interpretability.

pmc-13205368.title: Iron Oxide–Chitosan Macroporous Nanocomposite Hydrogels for Efficient Heterogeneous Electro-Fenton Degradation of Ciprofloxacin
pmc-13205368.creator: José Benito Pelayo-Vázquez, Daryl Rafael Osuna-Laveaga, José Patricio Peña-Jaramillo, Sergio Gómez-Salazar, Edgar David Moreno-Medrano, María Guadalupe Pérez-García
pmc-13205368.description: Ciprofloxacin (CIP) is a persistent fluoroquinolone antibiotic frequently detected in water bodies, and its efficient mineralization remains a challenge in wastewater treatment. In this work, iron oxide–chitosan macroporous nanocomposite hydrogels were developed as heterogeneous catalysts for the electro-Fenton degradation of CIP.

pmc-13272146.title: Development and external validation of a machine learning-based model for identifying advanced Parkinson’s disease
pmc-13272146.creator: Xiao-Ru Tan, Shao-Dan Zhou, Bing-Hua Lv, Fu-Zan Wei, Wen-Bin Teng, Chao Qin, Rui-Ting Hu
pmc-13272146.description: BackgroundIdentifying patients with advanced stage in Parkinson’s disease (PD) is crucial for timely therapeutic intervention, yet current tools rely on subjective clinical scales or expensive biomarkers. We aimed to develop and validate a predictive model based on routine blood biomarkers selected by machine learning algorithms.
